editorial: Fees are shown in US dollars only; no rupee conversions (owner decision, 2026-11-02).
Use the next year (2027) only in evergreen titles; keep 2026 where the post reports 2026 data.
Append the brand suffix to a title only if the whole title stays within 60 characters.
Reach the word minimum by adding useful, sourced sections, never by padding.
No em dashes in post content; plain apostrophes.
Post structure: 'In a nutshell' callout, tables where they help, visible FAQ that matches the faq array.

Title changes by ranking tier: strong pages (position <= 5 and >= 20 clicks) change minimally; page-1 pages (positions 5-10) first; page-2+ pages freely. Change a few at a time, recheck after 2-3 weeks and revert a title if it drops.

Internal links: 4-8 natural inbound links per target page, one sentence each, placed before the FAQ, Conclusion or Sources; avoid exact-match anchors to the sales page from posts that compete for the same query.
Never invent students, outcomes or statistics; sample timelines are labelled as examples.
Cite primary sources (usmle.org, ecfmg.org, nrmp.org) for fees, dates and policies.

notes: Search Console is read through AURORA's own GSC integration (/api/v1/gsc, read-only OAuth); no gsc MCP server is installed.
The Search Console account is a Full user, not an Owner: the Indexing API returns permission denied; reindex requests are manual (about 7-10 per day).
PageSpeed runs through the seo-data MCP server's free quota (PAGESPEED_API_KEY optional); it was exhausted on 2026-11-02.
SE Ranking and DataForSEO are not connected: no search volume, difficulty or backlink data.
SerpApi and Firecrawl calls cost credits: get an explicit credit budget from the owner first, no retries.
